name: sidereal-spellshot-without-the-class-bonus-skips-the-glimpse-but-can-still-load
notes: The generated body returned before the load for a non-Ranger champion; the Class Bonus gates only the Glimpse.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Glimpse X. Then you may load ...

engineBug.summary: Sidereal Spellshot could not be loaded into an Aetherwing unless the champion was a Ranger.
